Author: DexModsOfficial

[b][color=#000000][font=Courier New][size=6]ABOUT[/size][/font][/color][/b]
[font=Verdana][size=3]Simple overlay for the "floppy beanie" that adds glasses and makes the beanie black. If asked I can do a few beanie/glasses recolors and upload as optional files. For now it's just gloomy, though.[/size][/font]

[color=#000000][font=Courier New][size=6][b]INSTALLATION/ACQUISITION[/b][/size][/font][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]download the mod with Vortex (or install manually if that's your thing)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]buy the Floppy Beanie from the hat merchant or add to inventory with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]wear and enjoy (optional)[/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#000000][font=Courier New][size=6][b]REQUIRED[/b][/size][/font][/color]
[font=Verdana][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
